hero.description: Final-year computer science student in Dhaka. I ship production software and do applied machine learning research.

intro.name: Ikramul Hasan Moral
intro.title: Full-Stack Developer & ML Researcher
description: I started programming in 2022 with simple MERN apps and competitive programming problems. Since then I've shipped real products: the live RimonsIELTS e-learning platform, which I engineer and run as the sole remote engineer, and Advyon, a legal-tech platform built by a five-member team I led to Champion at the UIU CSE Project Show.

I'm finishing my B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering at United International University with a 3.94 CGPA and eight merit scholarships so far: six at 100% for ranking in the top 3% each trimester, one at 50%, and one at 25%. Lately I've moved into research. My FYDP-II thesis trains physics-informed neural networks on differential-equation residuals, and side studies range from physics-residual attack detection to AI-generated image forensics.

As an undergraduate teaching assistant for over a year, I support students in DBMS, DSA-I, ICS, and SWE lab courses. Alongside the degree I work as the solo software engineer at RimonsIELTS. Early on I solved 500+ problems across Codeforces, LeetCode, and HackerRank, but I stopped competitive programming more than a year ago; the algorithmic grounding stayed.

values.title: Problem Solving
values.description: Five hundred solved contest problems taught me to break a hard problem into small pieces before writing any code.

values.title: Research Rigor
values.description: Reproducible experiments, verified baselines, and metrics I can defend under questioning. The same discipline applies to my code.

values.title: Ship Real Things
values.description: I build software people actually rely on, whether that means wearable firmware, a REST API, or a student portal.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.quote: The best way to learn is by building and teaching.
philosophy.description: I learn by building things, then teaching them. Explaining a concept to a struggling student is the fastest way to find the gaps in my own understanding.

items.description: Defended FYDP-II on physics-informed neural networks for the Lorenz-1960 ODE system (supervised by Dr. Muhammad Nomani Kabir). The manuscript is submitted to ICEEICT 2027, and a windowed PINN study for longer horizons is archived alongside it.
The only engineer behind the live IELTS preparation platform at rimonsielts.com: a Next.js 15 student portal, an Express + TypeScript API, a React admin, and a Python central service.
Supporting DBMS, DSA-I, ICS, and SWE lab courses. I run lab sessions, design assignments, and hold office hours.

items.company: CSE Week Contest & SE Lab Project Show

Expected graduation January or February 2027. CGPA 3.94/4.0 with eight merit scholarships so far, six of them at 100%.
